parameters.query: SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.title, p.author, p.language, p.intelligence_data, c.id AS char_id, c.name AS char_name, c.role AS char_role, c.description AS char_desc, l.id AS loc_id, l.name AS loc_name, l.type AS loc_type, l.description AS loc_desc, sc.summary AS scene_summary, sc.location AS scene_location, sc.emotional_tone, sc.time_period FROM projects p LEFT JOIN characters c ON p.id = c.project_id LEFT JOIN locations l ON p.id = l.project_id LEFT JOIN scenes sc ON p.id = sc.project_id WHERE p.id = $1 AND p.state = 'understood'

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "{{ $env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'llama3' }}",
  "prompt": "Generate a comprehensive Story Bible for a novel called '{{ $('Execute Logic').item.json.title }}' by '{{ $('Execute Logic').item.json.author }}'.

Characters: {{ JSON.stringify($('Execute Logic').item.json.characters.slice(0, 10)) }}
Locations: {{ JSON.stringify($('Execute Logic').item.json.locations.slice(0, 10)) }}
Themes: {{ JSON.stringify($('Execute Logic').item.json.themes) }}

The Story Bible should include:
1. Premise/Logline
2. Genre and subgenres
3. Setting (world, time period, rules)
4. Main plot summary
5. Subplot summaries
6. Character arcs
7. Theme analysis
8. Tone and mood
9. Conflict resolution
10. Sequel/series potential

Return as JSON with keys: premise, genre, setting, main_plot, subplots, character_arcs, themes, tone, conflicts, sequel_potential.",
  "stream": false,
  "format": "json"
}

={
  "model": "{{ $env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'llama3' }}",
  "prompt": "Generate a Style Bible for adapting the novel '{{ $('Execute Logic').item.json.title }}' into visual media.

Include:
1. Visual style references (cinematography, color palettes)
2. Art direction (set design, costume design)
3. Lighting style per emotional tone
4. Camera movement philosophy
5. Editing rhythm
6. Sound design approach
7. Music genre and instrumentation

Scenes: {{ JSON.stringify($('Execute Logic').item.json.scenes.slice(0, 5)) }}

Return as JSON with keys: visual_style, art_direction, lighting, camera, editing, sound, music.",
  "stream": false,
  "format": "json"
}

={
  "model": "{{ $env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'llama3' }}",
  "prompt": "Generate a Timeline Bible for the novel '{{ $('Execute Logic').item.json.title }}'.

Scenes: {{ JSON.stringify($('Execute Logic').item.json.scenes.slice(0, 15)) }}

Include:
1. In-story chronological timeline
2. Story beat mapping
3. Character presence timeline
4. Cause-effect chains
5. Time period details
6. Potential timeline inconsistencies to watch for

Return as JSON with keys: chronological_timeline, story_beats, character_presence, cause_effect_chains, time_periods, inconsistency_warnings.",
  "stream": false,
  "format": "json"
}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO bibles (project_id, bible_type, content, locked, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, 'story', $2::jsonb, true, NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (project_id, bible_type) DO UPDATE SET content = $2::jsonb, locked = true, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO bibles (project_id, bible_type, content, locked, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, 'style', $2::jsonb, true, NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (project_id, bible_type) DO UPDATE SET content = $2::jsonb, locked = true, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO bibles (project_id, bible_type, content, locked, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, 'timeline', $2::jsonb, true, NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (project_id, bible_type) DO UPDATE SET content = $2::jsonb, locked = true, updated_at = NOW()
UPDATE projects SET state = 'biblified', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1
INSERT INTO events (project_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES ($1, 'bibles_built', $2::jsonb, NOW())
